📖 How to use

      
  1. Enter the dividend and the divisor.
  2. Press Divide to run the long division.
  3. Read each bring-down step, then the quotient and remainder.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Can I divide decimals?
This tool works with whole numbers only, so the bring-down steps stay exact.
What does the remainder mean?
It is what is left over after the divisor has been subtracted as many whole times as possible: dividend = divisor × quotient + remainder.
Can the divisor be zero?
No — division by zero is undefined, so the tool asks for a non-zero divisor.
